title: Pax Silica vs WAICO: Will Central Asia Have to Pick a Side? (The Diplomat, Catherine Putz, Sept 8, 2026)
notes: The Diplomat (recognized APAC policy outlet), Catherine Putz, 2026-09-08. Kazakhstan = only country in BOTH blocs: joined Pax Silica 2026-06-27 (Madiyev, 2nd Pax Silica Summit DC), then WAICO founding member (28 others) at WAIC 2026 Shanghai. Counts: Pax Silica 24 signatories (Taiwan non-signatory participant); WAICO 37 members (Bangladesh observer). Pax Silica = State Dept 'flagship effort on AI and supply chain security'. WAICO = AI governance org, Guterres attended. Reuters mid-Aug: undated draft State Dept letter to 35 AI Opportunity Statement signatories - 'To be part of everything is to be part of nothing', membership 'cannot be held alongside duplicative initiatives'; not yet sent. Kapur visited KZ/UZ early Aug. Uzbekistan requested Pax Silica (Sidikov: 'We are ready to sign'). US 'losing the race for Central Asia's critical minerals' (Lemon/Jardine).
